correctness.rationale: Definitions and counts follow from Latin uniqueness. The 576-element exhaustive census is exactly the union of two disjoint isotopy orbits of sizes 432 and 144. Exact integer Smith normal forms are cyclic (37 units), Klein (36 units, one 2), giving H2=Z^11 in both and H1=0 versus Z/2. Van Kampen presentations on 37 generators reduce by explicitly valid Tietze eliminations to empty (cyclic) and <t|t^2> (Klein). The former is a wedge of 11 two-spheres by Hurewicz and Whitehead. The submitted verifier reconstructs every finite object.

value.rationale: A current flabby-sheaf theorem raises a motivated structural question about weakening global flabbiness to uniformly surjective face restrictions. The exact two-isotopy-class order-four classification supplies a concrete topological boundary: identical 12/48/48 face counts and uniform fibre data, yet trivial versus Z/2 fundamental groups, with genuine H1 torsion. This detects information not supplied by the known local conditions, provides a precise finite model for obstructions to globalization, and avoids arbitrary parameter slices.
